purpose: Predeclared small-matrix suite for the resumed optimization campaign

execution_modes.reporting: Keep launch and Graph results separate; compare each candidate against the tuned dense baseline in the same mode and CSV row

input_scenario.transforms: Recompute every input-dependent transform in every timed invocation, including each captured Graph launch

quick.purpose: Diagnostic optimization screening; cannot establish final acceptance

baseline.same_contract: Original BF16/FP16 inputs, FP32 output, same shape/layout/alpha/beta and timing mode

numeric_gate.reference: FP64 plain GEMM from original rounded BF16/FP16 inputs; no S/T transformations
numeric_gate.expression: eF_solution <= 3*eF_dense + floor for every fresh correctness trial

acceptance.scope: Assess BF16 and FP16 independently, using the full configuration and at least two neighboring predeclared square sizes within the same algorithm version, variant and execution mode
acceptance.noise: Median speedup must exceed measurement noise; retain group-mean timings, p10/p90/CV and logs. These distributions are not confidence intervals
acceptance.backend: A passing dense fallback validates ordinary GEMM routing and does not certify SW or establish SW speedup
acceptance.uncertified: Numerically failing or unchecked SW results remain experimental and cannot enable Auto
